due_when.clears_when: A guard pair whose satisfying sets are disjoint is detected BEFORE it reds main. Verified by the detector firing on a DELIBERATELY CONSTRUCTED conflicting pair that is not one of the two known instances — a detector validated only against the cases it was written from proves nothing. It must cover BOTH sub-shapes or say explicitly which one it does not cover: a path-only detector that stays silent on a content conflict is the unprovenanced-diagnostic shape (a clean negative that checked one of two conditions). NOT SUFFICIENT: fixing the two live instances (MI-191 is doing that; it removes two points, not the class); a green guard suite (both instances were green ALONE); or an enumeration whose candidates are un-adjudicated — 19 candidates with 1 verified is not a detector, it is a list.
